user_outcomes: Bind the existing KONTUR readiness, activation, responsibility, ledger, host and Game Companion evidence lines into one reviewable family map
Expose established versus planned interfaces, frontier freshness, uncertainty and non-effects without collapsing member roles
Preserve separate human-controlled decisions for consolidation, activation review and pilot-evidence admission
anti_goals: Do not activate KONTUR, designate a host, start a runtime, mutate a ledger or grant execution authority
Do not generate live Game Companion responses, proactive/background activity, gameplay or account control
Do not create profiling, engagement optimization, cross-game preferences, total-history capture or production-readiness claims
Do not promote KONTUR, Game Companion or any family member into Stable Core
target_contexts: Repository-level consolidation of existing KONTUR component and pilot evidence
Local compatibility review before any separate activation or runtime decision
Privacy-minimized successor planning for the product family

actors.description: Human owner of the family-contract scope and consolidation disposition.
responsibilities: Reject stale, incomplete or overclaiming packets
Preserve separate activation and runtime decisions
actors.authority_source: Explicit human assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Human reviewer who may refer a fresh packet to the already separate activation-review process.
responsibilities: Review readiness, host, frontier and preflight evidence
actors.authority_source: Explicit human assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Human reviewer of Game Companion dependency and privacy-minimized field evidence.
responsibilities: Distinguish pilot evidence from production readiness
Exclude profiling, engagement optimization and raw history
actors.authority_source: Explicit human assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Local validator for exact family identities, paths, interfaces and non-effects.
responsibilities: Check repository paths and representative component tests
Perform no activation, mutation or network action

actors.description: Bounded field-pilot line; not a server responsibility holder or Stable Core.
responsibilities: Avoid live response generation, proactive activity, gameplay control and profiling
actors.authority_source: No independent authority; bounded by pilot-specific contracts

inputs.description: Exact member, path, edge and consolidation-policy manifest.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: All six members, six edges and non-transfer fields validate
inputs.freshness_policy: Any member, path, edge, policy, contract or frontier change creates a successor manifest

inputs.description: Six-axis readiness, aggregation, signal, dry-run acceptance and activation-frontier evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Exact producer/type/digest bindings, freshness and activation non-effects pass
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to exact capture, epoch, validity horizon and repository frontier

inputs.description: Kernel, policy, lifecycle, lease, fencing, generation, ledger, replica and recovery evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Representative kernel and ledger validators pass with append-only predecessor lineage
inputs.freshness_policy: Any kernel, policy, ledger, replica, recovery or schema change creates successor review

inputs.description: Preflight, human review, host observation, eligibility, designation and reobservation evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Eligibility, designation, binding, activation and observation remain distinct and no activation is claimed
inputs.freshness_policy: Any frontier, host, readiness, policy or review-packet change invalidates the packet

inputs.description: Game Companion seven-layer dependency contract and transitive validation evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Seven layers, exact artifact bindings, six adjacent edges and downstream validation pass
inputs.freshness_policy: Any bound pilot artifact or workflow change creates successor review

inputs.description: Selected privacy-minimized terminal, recovery, resource and interruption evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Raw history, transcript, identity correlation and behavioral profile are absent
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to exact sanitized receipt and pilot frontier

inputs.description: Human challenge or correction bound to one exact predecessor family packet.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Disputed member, edge, evidence, status, frontier or non-effect is identified
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to exact predecessor packet until a successor challenge receipt

classes.retention_limit: Until readiness expiry or successor capture

classes.collection_scope: Structural holder, scope, generation, lease, fencing, transition and recovery lineage
classes.minimization_rule: No execution authority, legal responsibility, moral blame or scalar responsibility score
classes.retention_limit: Through declared ledger and audit horizon

classes.collection_scope: Minimum preflight, frontier, host eligibility/designation and human-review bindings
classes.minimization_rule: No credentials, secrets, live command material, host mutation or reusable authority
classes.retention_limit: Until expiry, frontier change, rejection or successor review
classes.disclosure_scope: Human family owner and activation reviewer

classes.collection_scope: Exact Game Companion layer bindings, validator outcomes and pause/recovery evidence
classes.minimization_rule: No behavioral, psychological, mood or attention profiling; no engagement optimization, cross-game preference graph or total-history capture
classes.retention_limit: Until exact pilot evidence is superseded
classes.disclosure_scope: Human pilot reviewer and family owner

classes.collection_scope: Sanitized terminal, recovery, latency/resource and interruption evidence

classes.retention_limit: Until family review and contestability close
classes.disclosure_scope: Human pilot reviewer and family owner

classes.collection_scope: Only the disputed family member, edge, evidence, status, frontier or non-effect

classes.retention_limit: Until challenge resolution and successor receipt
classes.disclosure_scope: Human family owner and assigned reviewer

analysis_effects.description: Validate exact members, paths, edges and non-transfer boundaries.
Review established and planned interfaces without merging member roles.
Inspect readiness and dry-run acceptance without activation.
Review kernel and ledger lineage without state or ledger mutation.
Review preflight, eligibility and designation evidence without activation, host designation or control.
Review the seven-layer chain without live responses, proactive activity or gameplay control.
Assemble privacy-minimized pilot evidence for human review.

human_gates.trigger: Before a family packet is accepted as the current planning candidate
human_gates.expires_after: Any material member, path, interface, evidence, policy, contract or frontier change

human_gates.trigger: Before a packet may be referred to the separate KONTUR activation-review process
human_gates.expires_after: Readiness expiry or any frontier, host, policy, evidence or review change

human_gates.trigger: Before Game Companion evidence is included in a family packet
human_gates.expires_after: Any pilot artifact, privacy boundary, outcome receipt or frontier change

contestability.challenge_input_scope: Member identity, canonical path, edge, evidence status, frontier, readiness, activation boundary, pilot evidence, data boundary and non-effect

dependencies.relationship: Consumes typed evidence, authority, action-gate and successor-state distinctions
Optional future expression of review and handoff requests without execution admission
Optional future carrier of exact-bound evidence; unused for external effects here
Optional protective review of future effect candidates; not activation authority

receipts.purpose: Record exact member inventory, paths, edge status and non-transfer boundaries.
assertions: Manifest hash and frontier are bound
Every member and edge is explicitly classified
non_effects: The receipt does not activate a component or prove production readiness
Family membership grants no data, authority or responsibility transfer

receipts.purpose: Record human-reviewed consolidation, uncertainty, exclusions and successor planning state.
assertions: The family packet and human disposition are explicit
Pilot evidence remains distinct from production readiness
non_effects: Acceptance does not activate KONTUR, designate a host, start a runtime or grant execution authority
The receipt is not an ActionPermit or successor permit

receipts.purpose: Record whether one exact fresh packet may be referred to separate activation review.
assertions: Frontier, readiness, host and preflight evidence were reviewed
Referral disposition and expiry are explicit
non_effects: The receipt issues no activation command, responsibility state or execution authority

receipts.purpose: Record whether sanitized Game Companion evidence is admitted as bounded pilot evidence.
assertions: Dependency-chain and minimization evidence are bound
Inclusion or exclusion and reasons are explicit
non_effects: Pilot evidence is not production readiness
The receipt authorizes no live response, proactive activity, gameplay control or profiling
The pilot is not a server responsibility holder or Stable Core

receipts.purpose: Record a challenge, predecessor evidence, reasons and corrected successor family state.
assertions: The challenge is bound to the exact predecessor packet
Human disposition and successor state are explicit
non_effects: The receipt does not erase predecessor evidence
An upheld packet is not universal safety or legal compliance
Challenge handling creates no activation or execution authority

criteria.metric: All six members have exact roles, status and paths
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of required members and paths are repository-resolvable
criteria.falsification_condition: A required member or path is absent, substituted or ambiguous

criteria.metric: Every edge preserves authority, responsibility, activation and shared-data non-transfer
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of edges keep transfer, activation and access fields false
criteria.falsification_condition: Any edge silently transfers authority, responsibility, activation or data access

criteria.metric: Readiness and referral remain distinct from activation and execution
criteria.threshold: Zero family or referral receipt claims activation or execution
criteria.falsification_condition: A readiness or referral artifact activates KONTUR or grants execution authority

criteria.metric: Kernel and ledger evidence preserve lease, fencing, generation and append-only lineage
criteria.threshold: Representative kernel and ledger validators pass
criteria.falsification_condition: A stale, divergent, replayed or rewritten transition is accepted

criteria.metric: Seven Game Companion layers remain exact-bound and transitively validated
criteria.falsification_condition: Bound drift or missing downstream validation is accepted

criteria.metric: Field evidence excludes raw history, identity correlation and profiling
criteria.threshold: Zero raw transcript, behavioral profile or unnecessary device-history fields
criteria.falsification_condition: Raw history, identity correlation, profiling or engagement optimization enters the packet

criteria.metric: No activation, designation, ledger write, runtime start, message, account control or other external effect
criteria.falsification_condition: Any external mutation occurs under this contract

excluded_artifacts: KONTUR runtime state, activation commands, host credentials, leases and production deployments
Game Companion user data, raw game history, transcripts, profiles and external account state
Third-party models, games, devices, hosting services and actuators
Future family versions, general responsibility ideas and unlisted artifacts
ip_boundary.license_scope: Repository license; exact KONTUR Product Family Contract v0.1 artifacts only

assertions: Product boundary described for the declared version and frontier
Effects are descriptive and denied by default
Human gates and contestability are explicit
The family member inventory and established/planned interfaces are explicit
Readiness, activation, responsibility state, ledger evidence and product-pilot evidence remain distinct
KONTUR Game Companion remains a bounded pilot line rather than a server responsibility holder
All family review effects are local and non-executing
non_effects: KONTUR Product Family Contract != KONTUR Activation
Game Companion Pilot != Server Responsibility Holder
Live Host Eligibility != Live Host Designation
Pause or Recovery Evidence != Successor Authority
